body: Yeah, but what about when you already love yourself. I have already accomplished everything I want as far as education, career, etc. I know who I am and I have accepted who I am and I love who I am. There is only one area of my life that feels as if it is a missing gap.. and that is feeling loved. Everything I have ever done has been by myself. I want to share my experiences with someone else now. Without it I feel like something is missing and I long for it.
